title: default-flow coverage (every seeded type ships a driving flow)
description: For each seeded agent TYPE, create a throwaway agent supplying NO flow, then prove the backend auto-attached that type's default prompts/agent_types/<type>/flow.json (flow present, enabled, start_state names a real state) AND that the attached flow actually DRIVES the conversation (turn-1 flow.active, the flow enters its start_state, at least one transition is evaluated, and for say-start types the start say text appears verbatim in the reply). debt_collection additionally asserts the compliance gate: no balance/amount is disclosed before identity is verified.
system_prompt: You are the agent under test. Follow your configured behavior and the current conversation-flow state instructions.

turns: I'd like to book an appointment.
I took my medication this morning.
Yes, now is a good time.
They started about two weeks ago.
Hi, I'd like to schedule something.
Tell me more about the renewal.
Sure, I can answer a few questions.
It was a good experience overall.
I'm looking for a solution for my team.
Hi, I'm interested in your product.
Hi, I'd like to rent a car.
I'm not confirming anything until you tell me what this is about.
I don't understand how to solve for x.
